title: Nine-month trajectory, risk map, and coaching notes
content:
Purpose: quick, messy personal scratch to prep for upcoming 1:1s and the mid-cycle calibration. Focus is on what to show vs what to ask for. Not polished — meant to be conversational notes and testable hypotheses.

High-level intent (9 months):
- Move from IC generalist -> strategic people partner for product infra org.
- Demonstrate ability to run a cross-functional program end-to-end (discover -> design -> rollout -> measure).
- Build two repeatable artifacts: a hiring rubric for infra roles and a readiness checklist for private deployment onboarding.

Key outcomes I want to own (measurable signals):
- Hiring rubric: used in 3 hires this cycle; 80% hiring-manager satisfaction in post-hire retrospective.
- Onboarding checklist: reduces mean time-to-first-request-handled for new infra engineers by 30% in Q1 after rollout.
- Program: lead one cross-team initiative (billing/usage telemetry cleanup) reducing data discrepancy rate by 50%.

Evidence bank (snippets to use in 1:1 / calibration):
- 2025-11-08: Led kickoff with infra, billing, and analytics — defined scope and owner list (link in JIRA-HR-5012). Quick wins identified: TTL misconfig, schema mismatch.
- 2025-12-02: Drafted hiring rubric prototype; tested with 2 hiring managers (SRE, Serving Runtime). Feedback: rubric useful but too granular on systems design — iteration note.
- 2026-01-10: Piloted onboarding checklist with new contractor (Ravi); reduced handover ambiguity; contractor delivered first PR within 5 days (was ~12 historically).
- Ongoing: weekly office hours with two hiring managers to iterate rubric language.

Risks and mitigations (risk ladder):
- Risk: rubric adoption stalls (managers revert to old templates). Mitigation: drop-in sessions + import into Greenhouse job templates + pair-review first 2 hires.
- Risk: program scope creeps and stalls. Mitigation: hard stop milestones (MVP in 6 weeks), explicit success metric, and reassign scope if blocked.
- Risk: I get overloaded and lose headspace for strategy. Mitigation: triage tasks weekly, push back on new deep work commitments that don't map to outcomes.

Coaching asks for manager (what I want from next 1:1):
- Feedback on the rubric: where am I over-indexing on detail vs signal? Which candidate signals matter most to you?
- Prioritization aid: help me decide between owning the billing program vs supporting the dedicated capacity hiring push. Ask: which has more upside for my growth and visibility?
- Sponsor ask: introduce me to product infra lead (Anika?) for alignment and to get permission to own the telemetry cleanup.

Concrete asks and timing (what I will say):
- "I want to lead the billing telemetry cleanup as a 6-week MVP. Can I get a green light and a named partner on product analytics?" (ask in next 1:1)
- "I'd like to convert the hiring rubric into a Greenhouse template and pilot it on the next two SRE hires. Can I get 2 hours of your time for the pilot post-interview?" (ask within 2 weeks)
- "Can you help me be introduced to the head of product infra as a next step for sponsorship?" (ask next 1:1)

Mini experiments & learning plan (3 tactics to prove readiness):
1) Rapid rubric iteration loop: run rubric on 3 recent hires (post-hoc) to detect false positives/negatives. Deliverable: one-pager with 3 changes. Deadline: 4 weeks.
2) Onboarding checklist A/B: roll checklist for two new starters and measure time-to-first-meaningful-contribution. Deliverable: small dashboard + retrospective notes. Deadline: next hire cycle.
3) Run a 2-week async working session to align stakeholders on telemetry definitions; outcome: agreed schema and owner list.

Conversation anchors (bullet lines I will use in 1:1):
- "Here are 3 measurable things I will deliver in nine months and how I will track them."
- "I need help prioritizing high-leverage programs; I see two options and I want your read on which builds more product infra credibility."
- "Small ask: can you sponsor an intro to product infra leadership so I can align scope and get resources?"

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Add rubric examples from Serving Runtime interviews (Priya to share).
- Draft Greenhouse import mapping.
- Build quick dashboard template (copy from analytics team).

Open questions (for myself + manager):
- Is being the named owner of a cross-functional cleanup sufficient signal for promotion readiness, or do I need a second, sticky program?
- What does success look like at the next level in people-ops for infra-specific partnering?

Notes to self (tone + posture): keep it short, show measurable outcomes not activity. Use the one-pager to drive the meeting. Open with two asks, leave time for coaching.

TODOS (next 7 days):
- Finalize rubric v0.3 and email to Lucas + Priya for quick read (Due: 2026-02-20).
- Book 30m with manager for "decision on billing vs hiring" (Due: 2026-02-22).
- Capture onboarding checklist feedback from Ravi in checklist doc (Due: 2026-02-18).

End of scratchpad. Keep updating after each 1:1 — this doc is my running timeline and evidence ledger.
